session_read: Broad down day across the book's factor (SMH -2.1%, VIX +4.8% to 15.61) landed on top of the heaviest single-day portfolio turnover in weeks -- 7 full exits, 2 new positions, several adds/trims, all confirmed via email by smith-ledger. Book drawdown -10.98% crossed the correction_state half-warn threshold (not risk-off; policy warn line is -15%). AI-capex concentration jumped to ~95% of the book as ALAB and FSLR were both classified into the theme rather than treated as diversifiers. The idea-generation layer's 30d hit rate remains weak (21.1% overall) against a strong 67.5% stop-loss win rate, so this run's 7 new proposals were sized conservatively and a stacking conflict between an already-accepted MSFT sell and a fresh one was caught before it could be actioned twice.
